title: Memory card matching game
when: The user wants a memory game where cards are flipped two at a time to find matching pairs, with moves and time counted.
prompt:
Goal: Fair shuffles, flawless pair logic, smooth flips and a game that a screen reader user can play.
Steps:
1. Deck of pairs (8 for 4x4, 18 for 6x6) of shapes or words, Fisher Yates shuffled with injectable random.
2. logic.mjs flip(state, i) with states idle, oneUp, twoUp: a match stays, a mismatch is marked to flip back; count moves and matches.
3. app.js waits 800 ms before hiding a mismatch and ignores clicks meanwhile; the timer starts on the first flip.
4. Cards are buttons with aria-label "Card 5, hidden" or "Card 5, star"; matched ones disabled.
5. CSS 3D flip (rotateY, backface-visibility hidden); under prefers-reduced-motion swap faces instantly.
6. Win dialog with moves and time; best per size in localStorage guarded; status in aria-live.
7. test.mjs: each face twice, match and mismatch, third click ignored.
Quality bar:
- Grid stays square on phones.
- Faces are distinct in shape, not only color.
- Restart reshuffles.
Pitfalls:
- Clicking the same card twice counts as a match.
- Three cards up at once.
- Shuffling with sort and Math.random.
Verify:
- [ ] Reduced motion rule exists.
- [ ] Cards labeled.
- [ ] Logic tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (deck and flips), test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo da memoria para criancas com animais
examples.output: 4x4 grid of animal names, flip animation, "24 moves, 1:12"
